description: The source identifies this geodatabase of potential riparian polygons as an intended input to ALCES cumulative-effects simulation, including oil/gas activity and road construction. Variable buffers use stream Strahler order and natural region. Native time-span fields cover 1981–1995. The provider explicitly reports poor spatial accuracy, says the dataset is not recommended for riparian analysis, and identifies an October 2011 DEM-derived product as better. This record preserves a historical source-defined simulation input with that warning; it does not endorse present analytical use. A ZIP descriptor is listed, but the geodatabase format version and contents are unknown. Geographic coverage is Alberta. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue carries the Alberta source identifiers and descriptive metadata. Native licence statements are Open Government Licence - Alberta. Access is labelled unrestricted but isopen is false; actual access and costs remain unverified. HEAD checks returned 200 for the CUDC landing page and 403 for the original Alberta landing page.
